name: Ministry of Law

scam_info.sample: Since February 2026, at least 98 cases have been reported, with total losses amounting to at least $8.5 million.
scam_info.notes: Joint MinLaw-SPF GOIS advisory: fake telco/bank staff hand victims on to fake MinLaw officials ("safety accounts", valuables handover). Narrative only.

scam_info.sample: including from a caller falsely identifying himself as a Ministry of Law officer by the name of “Jason Lam” or “Lam Teck Yong, Jason”. There is no such officer in MinLaw.
scam_info.notes: Names a fictitious officer persona (an entity_name indicator) and describes doctored MinLaw staff passes sent via WhatsApp.
